description.en: Adds three tools over the TypeSafe Jev decision model: ask typed questions with probabilities, route content to one of a fixed set with a confidence, and screen untrusted text for prompt injection. Also screens results from fetch-like tools before the model reads them, and reports session cost.
description.zh: 接入 TypeSafe Jev 决策模型，提供三个工具：以带概率的类型化问题做判断、把内容路由到固定选项之一并给出置信度、筛查不可信文本中的提示注入。同时会在模型读取之前筛查抓取类工具的结果，并统计会话成本。
